articles.summary: Bench shutdown migration is the process of moving your books off Bench after its platform went dark on December 27, 2024, rebuilding the ledger in QuickBooks Online or Xero, catching up unfinished months, and finishing any unfiled tax return. Indinero handles those steps as one engagement, with continuous operations since 2009.
articles.title: Bench Shutdown Migration Guide: A Clean Exit in 2026
